ms.report:
Prior to commencing the audit, it was imperative for us to first draft and submit our Proof of Milestones (PoM) proposals. This process, however, proved to be somewhat challenging as we encountered difficulties in accurately defining the precise components of the audit. Nonetheless, we persevered and successfully completed the audit, which had been previously reported in January monthly report. We are ready to merge all the findings and complete the proposal, but to for the sake of consistency of reporting as envisioned in this PoM, we have taken the initiative to submit key findings and corresponding screenshots that effectively demonstrate around 50% of the issues and concerns that were successfully addressed throughout the audit proces and address by our Plutus developer who improved the codebase based on them. 
Proof of evidence:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a9H2tL8i4tCanB-UgUi7pVkr4wCmuAqHvOzsvRpup_Q/edit?usp=sharing

ms.criteria: Code reviewed and merged by the team
ms.report:
We are pleased to announce the successful completion of the audit for Fracada V2. The audit process was a pivotal step in ensuring the security and reliability of our Plutus contract designed to fractionalize NFTs on the Cardano blockchain.
Key Highlights of Milestone 3:
・Audit Completion: The comprehensive audit, conducted by a third-party audit company VacuumLabs, has been concluded (link in the Gtihub README: https://github.com/dcSpark/fracada-il-primo). The audit encompassed a thorough review of the contract code, identifying vulnerabilities and potential areas for improvement.
・Addressing Auditor Concerns: A list of concerns and findings raised by the auditor was received and promptly addressed by our in-house Plutus developer. These concerns have been thoroughly reviewed, and necessary actions have been taken to resolve them.
・We are pleased to present a demo recording that highlights the recent updates to the codebase and provides an overview of the audit results.

Demo Recording Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1fnEIz1SzfOIV_j-z13-pHJxehPKbpz6p/view

We are delighted to confirm the successful conclusion of the Fracada V2 Audit proposal and updated the README to reflect this, in accordance with the milestones outlined during onboarding. As part of this Final milestone, we have accomplished the following:
・Fracada V2 Read.me Update: We have diligently updated the Fracada V2 Read.me, ensuring that it reflects the latest developments and provides important information about the project.
・Demo of Code Functionality and Improvements: To showcase the enhancements made to the codebase, we are excited to share a demo video. This video provides an insightful overview of the code's functionality and highlights the specific improvements that have been implemented.

We invite you to watch the demonstration of the code's functionality and the enhancements made by following this link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1b1XsSYalGRpH2SVHM1vb40p9GlpAR-Sx/view
